barcelona.text: Violent disturbances in Barcelona over a youth protest inspired by European mobilisations have left about a hundred people detained.
Night of clashes in Barcelona: 100 arrests, looting and dozens of fires reported.
Violence and looting in Barcelona: 128 arrests, including 73 minors.
The Catalan government and Barcelona city council were overwhelmed by a violent protest in the city.

fort-kochi.text: The Muziris Biennale in Kochi is described as aiming to become a true people's festival. The headline gives no dates or venue closures.

thiruvananthapuram.text: IMD issues red alert in 3 Kerala districts for October 25; schools and tourist spots shut in those districts.
Red alert issued in three Keralam districts on October 25 as Cyclone Arnab takes shape.
Landslide near Parassala derailed an express locomotive in Keralam, and six passenger trains were cancelled.
Three districts are on red alert and seven on orange warning for Sunday.

bengaluru.text: IMD has issued a rain alert for Bengaluru, along with Dakshina Kannada, Udupi and Chikkamagaluru.
Farmers are blocking a national highway, demanding withdrawal of the Warabandhi system. Travel on that route may be disrupted.

seoul.text: A taekwondo festival with participants from 40 countries is to be held in Gangnam.

lisbon.text: Police charged protesters in Lisbon and Porto, with several people injured in Portugal.
A police operation to remove protest tents in Portugal left 11 injured and 31 people detained.

vienna.text: Vienna tips feature free excursions offered today for Austria's national holiday (Nationalfeiertag).

prague.text: Thousands protested in Prague as the government advanced an overhaul of public media funding.
Protesters in Prague tried to storm parliament overnight; police repelled the attempt.
The Czech parliament is advancing a bill changing public media funding; staff are preparing for a strike.

kyoto.text: Typhoon No. 30 and an approaching warm low may bring warning-level heavy rain to the Kinki region, including Kyoto, from the 25th, with two rain peaks.
The autumn Jidai Matsuri procession, a moving historical parade, is taking place in Kyoto.
